items.title: Allan Jaffe Interview, 1969-04-16
items.q: Ione used to help us a lot, you know, and she used to stand over by the, by the gate.

ctx.x: So, I think that, even after, between September, and for the next few months, I would still pass on the kiddie, and so on. I think that was a little bit of a story. Yeah. I'm trying to...

See, we had a lot of trouble with the people across the street, noise problems. But we ended up closing the door behind the piano. Ione used to help us a lot, you know, and she used to stand over by the, by the gate. And no one came in the gate, you know. I don't mean no one, I mean, but, you know, in the course of the night, maybe, you know, five to ten people would actually, you know, come in that way. Most of the people come in that, the, the door is now closed. And... Uh, we closed that door, you know, like,…
